source_text: WE HAVE LOST MANY LIVES, WE'VE MADE MANY SACRIFICES, AND THE CHURCH HAS GROWN COLD. THE GOSPEL IS CAUGHT BETWEEN THE SWORD AND A WALL. BUT WE HAVE A TREMENDOUS OPPORTUNITY TO SHARE THE GOSPEL WITH OUR OWN PEOPLE. - RÓMULO SAUÑE
line: Text on screen: We have lost many lives, we've made many sacrifices, and the church has grown cold. The gospel is caught between the sword and a wall. But we have a tremendous opportunity to share the gospel with our own people. Rómulo Sauñe.
notes: Opening quotation on black; lines fade in at about 0:02, 0:06, 0:12, name at 0:18; fades out over aerial hills by 0:26.
Title appears on screen 0:33-0:44 over aerial hills, but 0:27-1:18 is real untranslated speech (user confirmed), so the title is read early, in the last clear seconds before speech starts.
